content.title: A condition
content.text:
```js
8 > 3
```

This expression produces `true`, so it can be used as a condition.

content.prompt:
Write an `if / else` that uses `temperature`:

- if `temperature` is greater than `30`, use `"Hot"`
- otherwise, use `"Not hot"`

feedback.incorrect: Check the requirements and compare your code with the expected structure.

content.question: What is the job of the condition?

options.text: It decides which branch should run.

feedback.correct: Correct answer: B. It decides which branch should run.

content.title: Forge takeaway & Lesson completion
takeaways: **Mental model:** A condition asks a question. The branch answers what the program should do for each result.
**Senior habit:** When reading conditional code, state the question in plain English before you trace the branch.
nextSteps: Complete the checkpoint and explain the mechanism in your own words. A wrong first prediction is expected; the mastery signal is whether you can explain the result and handle a changed case after feedback.

requirements: Screen-reader accessible code blocks and options
